law.title: Required position and method of turning at intersections (2)(a)
law.text: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: Both intersecting highways are two-directional: The approach for a left turn must be made in that portion of the right half of the highway nearest the centerline thereof.

cases.description: Near-centerline left-turn approach; Native 45-second recording, 900 frames, closest sampled full-body edge 0.586 m from authored approach centerline. Ego traveled about 108 m and ended on departure road 4.
judgments: Whether this is legally the nearest portion of the right half, public-highway status, and between-frame position remain unresolved

cases.description: Farther-right left-turn approach; Native 45-second recording, 900 frames. Full-body closest approach offset 0.804 m from authored centerline, versus 0.586 m for near branch; mid and final approach offsets were 2.455 m and 2.299 m. Ego completes turn and ends on departure road 4.
judgments: Whether either approach is legally the nearest portion of the right half, public-highway status, and between-frame position remain unresolved

cases.description: Imaginary equidistant centerline near approach; Native 45-second recording, 900 frames, closest sampled full-body edge 0.579 m from authored centerline. Ego traveled about 142 m and ended on departure road 4.
judgments: Statutory nearest portion, public-highway status, and between-frame position remain unresolved; centerline is an authored imaginary construction

cases.description: Imaginary equidistant centerline farther-right approach; Native 45-second recording, 900 frames. Full-body closest approach offset 0.804 m from authored centerline versus 0.579 m for near case; mid and final approach offsets 2.450 m and 2.299 m. Ego completes turn onto departure road 4.
judgments: Statutory nearest portion, public-highway status, and between-frame position remain unresolved; centerline is authored imaginary geometry

remaining_requirements_note: Farther approach and imaginary-centerline cases plus their imported comparisons remain pending. No final legal-position judgment or full law coverage is claimed.
